title: QUIC Compatible Version Negotiation Floor (RFC 9368)
purpose: Capture the RFC 9368 version_information transport-parameter floor and authenticated handshake validation that the repository already implements.
scope: This specification covers the RFC 9368 version_information transport-parameter floor: endpoints format and parse authenticated Version Information, client-sent lists include the chosen version, malformed values are rejected, and the authenticated chosen-version checks keep the connection version consistent. It does not cover the full compatible-version runtime-selection flow that would avoid an extra round trip; that follow-up remains a separate future slice.
context: RFC 9368 defines authenticated Version Information for QUIC version 1 and uses it to prevent downgrade attacks. The repository already carries the transport-parameter, bridge-state, and resumption snapshot plumbing for the floor, but the full compatible-version restart/selection behavior is still tracked separately in the gap ledger.

requirements.title: Emit authenticated Version Information
requirements.statement: An endpoint that supports compatible version negotiation MUST encode Version Information in the `version_information` transport parameter with a non-zero Chosen Version and a list of Available Versions that includes the Chosen Version when the endpoint acts as a client.

requirements.title: Reject malformed Version Information
requirements.statement: An endpoint that receives Version Information MUST treat zero Chosen Version values, zero Available Version values, misaligned payload lengths, and a client-sent list that omits the Chosen Version as parsing failures.

supplemental_sections.heading: Implementation Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This slice is intentionally narrow. It owns the authenticated Version Information floor and the transport-parameter snapshot paths that keep the encoded data stable. The full compatible-version restart/selection behavior from RFC 9368 Section 4 remains separate future work.
